mentions.name: Nezz
mentions.description: A platform that lets luxury brokers perform client due diligence, handle ownership transfers, and receive or issue payments in one place, merging the luxury retail market with banking. Brokers get instant payment, free deposits and payments, and protection from chargebacks.
mentions.problem: Luxury brokers face chargeback risk and transaction fees of 2-10% from payment processors and marketplaces.
mentions.source_excerpt: I have been working with a small team on a platform that allows luxury brokers to do due diligence on clients, ownership transfer and receive/issue payment all in one platform. We are pretty much merging the luxury retail market with banking.

evidence.value: I have been working with a small team on a platform that allows luxury brokers to do due diligence on clients, ownership transfer and receive/issue payment all in one platform. We are pretty much merging the luxury retail market with banking.
